_about: Pattern → method appropriateness mapping + inference partial-credit matrix. Loaded by DemandForecastEngine.computePartScores().

stationary.rationale: Flat-on-average data favours short-memory smoothers. Naive is the pedagogical baseline; MA and ES smooth white-noise without lag.

trending.rationale: Both methods explicitly model a linear-trend component. MA / ES will systematically under-forecast a rising series.

seasonal.rationale: True seasonal forecasting needs Holt-Winters or classical decomposition (NOT in the canonical 6 — audit D3). WMA with weights timed to the season is the best the canonical 6 can do; that is the documented limitation for this sim.
seasonal.limitation: No Holt-Winters in the canonical 6 — DF-2a kept the method set strict; Phase 2 may extend.

random.rationale: Pure white noise rewards minimum-effort methods. Sophisticated smoothers overfit; trend models hallucinate slope where there is none.

_about_inferencePartialCredit: matrix[guess][truth] → 0–100. Same pattern = 100; broad-category match (both flat-on-average; both non-flat) = 60; unrelated = 30; clear contradiction (random vs trending/seasonal) = 0.
